fields.Name: IT195 - Agent Extensions, Configuration Cascade, and Sandbox Enforcement
fields.Description: Real-database deterministic checks for Phase 2 BaseAgent Refactor (AEC1-AEC5). AEC1 verifies MJ: AI Agent Step Types DB persistence (14 built-ins + custom row), StepTypeID FK round-trip on AIAgentStep and AIAgentRunStep, and custom DB-backed BaseAgentStepHandler execution via AgentStepTypeRegistry. AEC2 verifies SQL-level 3-table IAgentConfiguration cascade (AIAgent.Configuration -> BaseAgentID chain -> AIAgentCategory.DefaultConfiguration -> AIAgentType.DefaultAgentConfiguration) and narrow-only security invariant clamping. AEC3 verifies bidirectional dirty-field Save() sync in MJAIAgentEntityServer and MJAIAgentTypeEntityServer. AEC4 verifies admin-only Configuration.helperPlugins and code-only seam (limits, actionPolicy) rejection in live Save(). AEC5 verifies #6852 UI-role ownership/RLS enforcement and non-admin sandbox rejection (BaseAgentID, CanRun, DriverClass, Isolation, MaxCostPerRun, TypeConfiguration.helperPlugins, and cross-user isolation) on both SQL Server and PostgreSQL. Self-cleaning throwaway fixtures.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: All 5 Agent Extensions & Configuration Cascade checks (AEC1-AEC5) pass against a real database with zero leaked fixture rows.
